victor_sheet.name: Blacklight
notes: Initiative 2 and Run 5 follow the audited Core-derived variant. The PDF prints 1 and 6; that disagreement is retained in CHARACTER_AUDIT.md.
Mighty 1/2/3 rows are stored as the highest level 3, without summing levels.
Extended Reach is absent from this primary sheet. Whip is unavailable at Rank 3.
This record preserves all listed powers, traits and tags. Read the adapter coverage report before simulation.

Same character attributes/resources as the preserved earlier record; table rules revised on 2026-10-27: one check per limb, preselected effects, both checks before effects/reactions, Shield before damage and both damage/effects before Riposte. No Rank progression invented.

assumptions: A printed Health DR dash is treated as zero for this experiment.
Karma, Focus attacks and noncombat abilities are not used.
Table literal Marvel damage pools replace the printed Core damage formula.
The separate Fast Hands reaction can only pay a Ranged Weapons power.
Point-Blank Parry does not target an unconscious attacker in this host.
Stopping Power does not follow up against an unconscious target in this host.
Shield and escape trigger identity is an explicitly selected hypothesis.
Close attacks and miss reactions between the two held actors are modeled.
Carrying, knockback, self-hit on a miss, third parties and multiple holds are not modeled.
A hold persists when the holder is Stunned in this experimental host.

limitations: exploratory incomplete official profile and one-dimensional field
self-hit, third parties, carrying and knockback during holds are not modeled
inside-attack trouble and Escape trigger identity are explicit hypotheses
hold persists when the holder is Stunned; Karma and Ram are not used
